description: Welcome to Agentic AI Hackathon 2026, an online innovation challenge organized by Proton Solutions. Artificial Intelligence is evolving beyond traditional chatbots and automation tools. Agentic AI introduces a new generation of intelligent systems capable of understanding goals, planning actions, making decisions, using tools, and executing complex tasks with minimal human intervention. This hackathon invites students, developers, researchers, and technology enthusiasts to explore the possibilities of autonomous AI agents and multi-agent systems. Participants are challenged to identify real-world problems and develop innovative Agentic AI solutions that demonstrate intelligence, autonomy, collaboration, and practical impact. Whether you are an individual innovator or part of a team, this is your opportunity to experiment with emerging AI technologies, showcase your technical skills, and transform your ideas into working solutions. Build intelligent agents. Automate possibilities. Shape the future. Organized by : Proton Solutions Event Format : Online Participation : Individual and Team
